issues.description: Attribute naming mismatch for the student-count fields: the problem statement's textual list of attributes (problem_statement.md) names them as 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents', while the UML diagram in the same problem statement and the reference solution actually declare them as 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents'. The template lecture file contains a TODO to add attributes but does not define them yet. This inconsistency can confuse students about the exact field names they must implement and which getter/setter/test names will be expected (e.g., getNumberOfInscribedStudents() vs getInscribedStudents()).
issues.suggestedFix: Unify attribute identifiers across all artifacts. Prefer using the explicit names 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents' (recommended because the UML and tests reference those names). Update the problem statement textual list to use the same identifiers as the UML and solution, and verify example method/test names (getters/setters) in the statement match the chosen names. Alternatively, if shorter names are preferred, update the UML, solution, and tests to use 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents' consistently.
